arguments.sql:
WITH top_stores AS (
    SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, COUNT(*) AS total_orders
    FROM main.orders AS o
    JOIN main.stores AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
    GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
    ORDER BY total_orders DESC, s.store_id
    LIMIT 2
)
SELECT t.store_id, t.store_name, t.total_orders,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.delivery_id IS NOT NULL THEN o.order_id END) AS delivered_orders,
       COUNT(d.delivery_id) AS delivered_matches
FROM top_stores AS t
JOIN main.orders AS o ON o.store_id = t.store_id
LEFT JOIN main.deliveries AS d
    ON d.delivery_order_id = o.delivery_order_id
    AND d.delivery_status = 'DELIVERED'
GROUP BY t.store_id, t.store_name, t.total_orders
ORDER BY t.total_orders DESC, t.store_id

WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT delivery_order_id
    FROM main.deliveries
    WHERE delivery_status = 'DELIVERED'
)
SELECT s.store_name,
       CAST(COUNT(d.delivery_order_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS delivered_ratio
FROM main.orders AS o
JOIN main.stores AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
LEFT JOIN delivered_orders AS d ON d.delivery_order_id = o.delivery_order_id
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s.store_id
LIMIT 1
